summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo, but nothing was run: the test suite was not executed, as instructed. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.finished_time field, finished derived from it, capture rules in update/advance, clearing in _reset/reset, new TimeElapsedColumn); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (__rich__ with in-method imports and TYPE_CHECKING Table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased/Added entry); tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn in test_columns with expected output re-derived by hand-tracing clock reads); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast). Nothing committed. The test_columns expected output is unverified: it was derived by tracing reads (BarColumn reads twice; start frame elapsed 0:00:37/0:00:36; captures 60 and 45 s; bar speed 2 to 1 byte/s; bar widths 33 to 25 and 23 to 16). Re-measured bar runs and elapsed cells match the trace. Tests test_track, test_progress_track, test_render, and test_progress_max_refresh are expected unchanged but were not run.
